name: io.github.LeanerCloud/cudly-mcp
description: Search and buy AWS/Azure/GCP reserved capacity (RIs, Savings Plans, CUDs) via any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: CUDLY_MCP_ENABLE_REAL_PURCHASES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 (or true) to let purchase tools execute real, money-spending purchases. Unset (the default) refuses every dry_run=false call before any provider or credential is touched -- see mcp/README.md 'Safety model'.

environmentVariables.name: CUDLY_MCP_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the JSONL audit log path for purchase attempts; set to an empty string to disable audit logging. See mcp/README.md for the current default path.
